newsitem.title: CHINA: China to hear appeal of dissident Wang Dan.
newsitem.headline: China to hear appeal of dissident Wang Dan.

text.p: A Chinese court will hear on Friday the appeal by dissident Wang Dan against his 11-year sentence for plotting to overthrow the government, his mother said on Thursday.

Wang Linyun said court officials informed her that she would be able to attend the Beijing Higher People's Court trial as one of two defence lawyers. Family members would also be allowed to sit in, she said.
The Beijing Number One Intermediate People's Court took less than four hours to convict and sentence Wang on October 30.

The jailing of Wang was the latest in a series of crushing blows to China's struggling pro-democracy movement. Most dissidents have already been forced into exile or are serving long sentences in prison or labour camps.
Wang had already served four years in prison for his role as a leader of the 1989 student demonstrations for democracy that were crushed by the military with heavy loss of life.
